title: Tidy status error logging and the stderr swap
lead: From the S17 review, not fixed. addEngineStatus logs the run-list error on every call, and the captureRunErrors helper swaps os.Stderr globally, which is unsafe under concurrent calls.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: From the S17 review, not fixed. addEngineStatus logs the run-list error on every call, and the captureRunErrors helper swaps os.Stderr globally, which is unsafe under concurrent calls.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - internal/daemon and internal/cli (where those helpers live), tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A run-list error is logged once per distinct failure, not per call.
- Error capture does not replace os.Stderr process-wide.
- Output text is unchanged.
